text.text_excerpt: This place is amazing. Off the beaten path, it is one of the best culinary secrets in Mid-City especially for breakfast. There is rarely a wait and everything is so affordable for being mouthwatering scrumptious. Way better than Ruby Slipper. Plus, the staff is always very sweet & helpful. I recommend trying the Roast Beef Debris your first time. It's hard to break out & try anything else after trying it. It's that good

I am a big fan of the Bittersweet Confections in the CBD and am so glad they just opened up this new location in Mid-City! The space is beautiful and has plenty of indoor seating. They also have a couple cute little tables outside although there wasn't any outlets that I could find for the outdoor seating. Their WiFi is nice and strong though! The food menu is also pretty decent and very reasonably priced. I ordered their Gouda grits and roast beef debris and they were to die for! Seriously the Gouda grits are unreal. So good!!!! They had some stuff in their grab and go coolers if you're in a rush and their sweets selection was nice and stocked. They had their signature macaroons, cakes, ...

What a great addition to Mid City's eateries. I had lunch here today, and my plan now is to become a regular. They're located in a cute corner building a couple of blocks off Carrollton, so they're super easy to get to. Upon entering I was greeted by an awesome guy who was so warm and welcoming. I placed my order for basil chicken salad and was offered a taste of pastry cream and chocolate stuffed Brioche. Um, yes, please. What a great surprise, and it was a pretty large taste. I enjoyed my delicious, decadent Brioche while I waited for my chicken salad. It felt so indulgent to have my desert before my main. My chicken salad arrived and was scrumptious. The portion size was very generous,...
